characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- All models gain Scout (0/2").
- Once per game, declare this ability in the Starting Phase. Enemy models with marked Wound boxes receive a -1 penalty to their Movement Statistic until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Cub has separate Wound boxes to Kazuo. Mark Wound boxes as usual from left to right. You must mark Kazuo's Wound boxes first. This model's Last Stand trait triggers when either Kazuo's 6 Wound boxes or the Cub's 2 Wound boxes are all marked.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has the Aware and Defensive traits while the Cub has unmarked Wound boxes. You may choose to lose these traits in a Melee Exchange but, if you do, any Damage done to this model will be applied to the Cub's boxes instead of Kazuo's.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model uses its Last Stand trait, it gains Activation Counters up to a maximum of 2 and all its Attacks are Critical Attacks in addition to any chosen Special Ability.

characteristics.name: Specials
characteristics.$text: Combo Attack (1), Sweep Attack (1), Eagle's Flight Defence (0)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- Loyal & Samurai models gain Reach on Katana Melee Weapons.
- You may choose one of the following in any starting phase. Each ability may only be chosen once. You may use two abilities per game.
  - Move each friendly model that is currently BtB with an enemy model until it leaves the enemy model’s Zone of Control.
  - All Ki Boosts cost one fewer Ki Token until the end phase.
  - Friendly models with marked wound boxes may reroll Defence dice until the end phase.
  - For each model currently Elsewhere using the Flank trait, immediately re-choose its arrival turn (this may be the current turn, however you may not choose turn 1) and table edge as if it just gained Flank.

Permitted [Hiroto, Loyal models]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Play during Deployment.
For the rest of the game, in the Starting Phase before the Tactical Test, if a Friendly model will Deploy using the Flank Trait that turn choose a Friendly model to gain Tactician (1).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In the End Phase you may place a Friendly Shiho model in BtB with this Terrain Elsewhere; that model gains Flank and returns to play using those rules.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Instead of declaring a table edge when using a model with Flank, you may note this Terrain element to be the model's entry point instead of a neutral table edge and Deploy it in contact with this Terrain element. This is Hidden information.
This Terrain must be Deployed on your half of the table and not in a Scenario Zone.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Wooden Stakes Terrain is considered [Difficult, Clear, Zero] Terrain for Enemy models and [Impassable, Clear, Zero] for Cavalry models.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Set this Terrain up only in a Scenario Zone.
It counts as a model (at 0 Rice Cost) when determining Zone Control.
When a model performs a Wait Action to Destroy this Terrain, it need not spend 2 Ki Tokens.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is in play, friendly Kyudoka models may use Flame Arrows Ki Feat as if it was written on their card.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is in play, when a friendly Loyal & Ashigaru Model spends a Virtue token, in addition to any other benefit chosen, that model may remove a Reload Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model declares a Wait Action to remove Reload Markers, its Ranged Weapons gain Lightweight until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is in play, friendly Yarimen models may use the Unassailable Ki Feat as if it was written on their card.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is in play, when a friendly Loyal & Ashigaru Model spends a Virtue token, in addition to any other benefit chosen, if that model performs a Scenario Action, remove one fewer Activation Counters at the end of the action. They must have the required number of Activation Counters to declare the Action.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- Friendly Models that are Elsewhere are ignored when calculating Pass Tokens.
- During the first turn of the game, models in this warband gain Endurance and do not suffer the melee penalty for having Run.
- Loyal & Samurai models gain Reach on Katana Melee Weapons.
- In the Starting phase for each Faction model that is Deployed using the Flank rules, an Enemy model must perform a Ki Challenge Test (7). If it fails, you may change that model’s facing.

Permitted [Samurai, Eagles, Ronin Kami, Ronin Eagles]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- Loyal & Samurai models gain Leadership [Ronin]:(1/6”)
- Ronin models gain Scout (1/1”) and Co-ordinated Attack [Loyal]
- Loyal & Samurai models gain Reach on Katana Melee Weapons.
- When a Loyal & Samurai model moves into BtB with an Enemy model this activation, it may make a normal Damage Roll when resolving a successful Sidestep Attack.
- After recruiting the Warband to the correct Rice Cost, choose another 15 Rice of cards as Reserves. These are not added to the main list but kept separate. The Warband with and without Reserves must be legal. Before Deployment you may switch cards in the Reserves with cards in the main list, the main list must remain legal. Show the new list to your Opponent before the game. In a timed event, you have 5 minutes to make substitutions.

Permitted [Shiho Faction Models, Ronin Models]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of any activation when another Friendly model spends one or more Virtue Tokens, this model may Walk 1".
While this model is in play, when a Friendly Loyal model spends a Virtue Token you may choose one of the following effects for that model:
- Walk this model 1".
- Move this model out of BtB with an Enemy model until it leaves that model's ZoC.
- This model gains Dodge (1) and Ranged Defence (1) until the End Phase.
- This model gains Endurance until the End Phase.

This model begins the game with one Luck Token.
Whenever a Friendly model within 6" of a model with a Luck Token makes a Fear Test, Attack Roll, Defence Roll, Damage Roll, or Opposed Ki Test, the model with the Luck Token may spend the Luck Token to re-roll one of the dice.

When this model is recruited into the Guerilla Warfare theme, add this ability as if it were written on the theme card:

- Until the End Phase, Friendly models make a normal Damage Roll when using Sidestep Attack, instead of rolling no damage.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- During deployment add up to two permitted Shiho Clan or Ronin,  Enhancements or Terrain cards that were not Recruited into the Warband to the Warband for free. You may not exceed the max value for these cards.
- While a Friendly Ashigaru model has a Virtue Token they gain Prowess [Defence, Ranged]:(1) and do not suffer Melee Dice Penalties due to States.
- Friendly Loyal & Samurai models gain Reach on Katana Melee Weapons.
- Ashigaru cost -1RC to recruit into this Warband.

Permitted [Ashigaru, Loyal, Ronin]

This model cannot draw LoS outside of BtB.

- bring it into BtB with the Attached model or

lf unsuccessful its activation ends before any movement and it removes an Activation Counter, then discard this card.

The Attached model loses Flank and Booted and may not gain these traits. 
This model always Deploys before other models, regardless of normal player order.
Deploy this model, then continue with Deploying Warbands following player order.

Before the first turn, you may remove one Pool Terrain element within 3" of a neutral table edge.

characteristics.name: Description

Enemy Damage Rolls are ignored if the individual dice values of the Damage Roll are the same number.

characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.name: Description

The first Enemy Damage Roll resulting from a Melee Exchange with the Attached model where the individual dice values of the Damage Roll are the same number is ignored; then discard this card.

When choosing which weapon to use during a Ranged Attack, the Attached model may choose to use this arrow in addition to a Dai Kyu.

characteristics.name: Unique Effects
characteristics.$text:
If the Attached model succeeds on an Attack Roll in a Melee Exchange while using this weapn then, until the end of the Melee Exchange it takes half Damage from any attack the Enemy model makes.

Requirement [Loyal & Samurai]

characteristics.name: Description

Requirement [Samurai]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When the Attached model causes Wounds in a Melee Exchange, after the exchange is complete you may choose one of the following:
- Attached model Heals 1 Wound.
- Enemy model suffers 1 Wound.
- Attached model gains +1 Melee Pool until the End Phase.

In the End Phase, the Attached model may spend 2 Ki Tokens; if it does, you may Attach this card to a Friendly model's card if it is BtB and Permitted.

Requirement [Loyal & Samurai]

characteristics.name: Description

- Enemy Damage Rolls on the Attached model are ignored if the individual dice values of the Damage Roll are the same number.
- Attached model provides Cover as if it were a terrain element.
- If the Attached model is Targeted by a Ranged Attack, the Enemy model gains double Reload Markers (if any).
- The Attached model loses Flank, Booted and cannot be used to replace a model with the Uncloak Ki Feat.

Requirement [Loyal & Samurai]
